resources.string: Everything this phone receives is kept in its MediaSync folder. A backup app on this phone can upload it from there.
This version of MediaSync has no backup to set up.
%1$s backs up the MediaSync folder on its own. On Pixel 2 to 5 that\'s free and unlimited in Storage saver. MediaSync uploads nothing itself.
Turn on backup for the %1$s folder: tap your profile picture, then Photos settings → Backup → Back up device folders. The folder is listed once the first photo has arrived.
Choose Storage saver: Photos settings → Backup → Backup quality. On Pixel 2 to 5 it doesn\'t use your Google storage.
%1$s on this phone, for %2$s to back up
%1$s backed up and removed from this phone
%1$s backs them up on its own, usually within minutes on Wi-Fi. MediaSync can\'t see when that\'s done. Once %1$s removes them to free up space, they count as backed up.
In %1$s, tap your profile picture, then Free up space. It removes only what\'s backed up.
Or let the phone do it: Smart Storage, in the storage settings, removes backed-up photos and videos when space runs low.
MediaSync never deletes these files itself.
